mod_shcommands_enabled.description: Enable the shell command executor module. WARNING: This module allows execution of arbitrary shell commands via XMPP messages — only enable in isolated, trusted environments (e.g., internal dev/test).

mod_shcommands_shell.description: Path to the shell interpreter used to execute commands. Typically `/bin/sh` or `/bin/bash`.

mod_shcommands_max_processes.description: Maximum number of concurrent shell command processes allowed at once. Prevents resource exhaustion.

mod_shcommands_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for each command execution. Commands exceeding this are terminated.

mod_shcommands_allowed_commands.description: List of command names/paths that users are permitted to invoke. Empty list = no restriction (⚠️ insecure). Always restrict to minimal set.

items.description: A command path or name (e.g., `/bin/ls`, `whoami`). Must be absolute path or valid shell builtin.
